complete_compared_chunks.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_entry_of_fixed
complete_compared_chunks.complete_source_chunk:
/-- A run ending in a designated live stop state first enters the stop states by its deadline,
and that first entry is already the final configuration, provided every stop configuration is
fixed by one step.

**Proof sketch.** Choose the least stop-state time with `Nat.find`. Minimality gives the
strict earlier-time cut. The fixed-step hypothesis keeps every subsequent configuration equal
to that first entry; `runFrom_add` then identifies it with the given final configuration. -/
theorem exists_first_entry_of_fixed {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*}
    {input : List Symbol} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (stop : State → Prop) (c d : Cfg k Symbol State input) (T : ℕ)
    (hfix : ∀ z : Cfg k Symbol State input,
      (∃ q, z.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step z = z)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, ¬∃ q, (tm.runFrom c j).state = some q ∧ stop q) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = d := by
  classical
  have hh : ∃ t, ∃ q, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q ∧ stop q :=
    ⟨T, by rw [hT]; exact hd⟩
  let t := Nat.find hh
  have ht : t ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hh (by rw [hT]; exact hd)
  have hs : ∃ q, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q ∧ stop q := Nat.find_spec hh
  have hfixed : tm.step (tm.runFrom c t) = tm.runFrom c t := hfix _ hs
  have hconst (n : ℕ) : tm.runFrom (tm.runFrom c t) n = tm.runFrom c t := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact runFrom_zero
    | succ n ih => rw [runFrom_succ_eq_step, hfixed]; exact ih
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun j hj => Nat.find_min hh hj, ?_⟩
  have he := tm.runFrom_add c t (T - t)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le ht, hT, hconst] at he
  exact he.symm

complete_compared_chunks.name: Turing.FinTM.emitter_first_entry
complete_compared_chunks.complete_source_chunk:
/-- A phase with an absorbing return state can be cut at its actual first
return while retaining its complete configuration endpoint.
**Proof sketch.** Choose the least return-state visit. Absorption identifies
its configuration with the known bounded endpoint. The bound proves existence
and bounds the first visit; it is never used to dispatch native control. -/
private lemma emitter_first_entry {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop]
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hfix : ∀ z : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, z.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step z = z)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, ¬∃ q, (tm.runFrom c j).state = some q ∧ stop q) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = d := by
  classical
  have hh : ∃ t, ∃ q, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q ∧ stop q := ⟨T, by rw [hT]; exact hd⟩
  let t := Nat.find hh
  have ht : t ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hh (by rw [hT]; exact hd)
  have hs : ∃ q, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q ∧ stop q := Nat.find_spec hh
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun j hj => Nat.find_min hh hj, ?_⟩
  have hconst : tm.runFrom (tm.runFrom c t) (T - t) = tm.runFrom c t :=
    Function.iterate_fixed (hfix _ hs) _
  have he := tm.runFrom_add c t (T - t)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le ht, hT, hconst] at he
  exact he.symm

complete_compared_chunks.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogFirstEntry
complete_compared_chunks.complete_source_chunk:
/-- A run reaching an absorbing control state has a least such entry, and its
configuration at that first entry is already the final configuration.
**Proof sketch.** Choose the least hit. Absorption makes its entire suffix
constant, so the bounded endpoint identifies the first-hit configuration. -/
private lemma catalogFirstEntry {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (q : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hfix : ∀ z : Cfg k Bool S w, z.state = some q → tm.step z = z)
    (hd : d.state = some q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some q) ∧ tm.runFrom c t = d := by
  classical
  have hh : ∃ t, (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q := ⟨T, by rw [hT, hd]⟩
  let t := Nat.find hh
  have ht : t ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hh (by rw [hT, hd])
  have hs : (tm.runFrom c t).state = some q := Nat.find_spec hh
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun j hj => Nat.find_min hh hj, ?_⟩
  have hconst : tm.runFrom (tm.runFrom c t) (T - t) = tm.runFrom c t :=
    Function.iterate_fixed (hfix _ hs) _
  have he := tm.runFrom_add c t (T - t)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le ht, hT, hconst] at he
  exact he.symm

complete_compared_chunks.name: Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape
complete_compared_chunks.complete_source_chunk:
/-- **W2 space row** (design §12 R3, decision 12.3;
annotates `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` beside its
`redirectTM_computes`/`redirectTM_live` contract pair). Redirection costs
no space, per tape and exactly: the redirected machine's tape actions are
the source's verbatim, before and after the source halt.

**Proof sketch.** `redirect_run`'s configuration correspondence preserves
work tapes and heads at every time (the live loop is stationary and the
simulation phase copies the source's tape actions), so the two head
trajectories coincide pointwise and the visited images agree. -/
theorem redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool)
    (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.spaceUsedByTape
        ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t i
      = M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t i := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff, (redirectTM_runFrom M haltOn x _).2.2.2.1]

complete_compared_chunks.name: Turing.startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le
complete_compared_chunks.complete_source_chunk:
/-- **The seam machine's space ledger, from any seam endpoint**: under the seam hypotheses of
`Turing.startupLoopTM_runFrom` (the startup `R` reaches `d` on `x` at exactly `T`, at `exit`,
not earlier, and `d` relabelled at `entry` is the embedding of the loop configuration `c`), if
the startup uses at most `B` cells by `T` and the loop `L`, run from `c`, uses at most `S ≥ 1`
cells on each of its tapes by `t`, then `Turing.startupLoopTM R exit L entry` uses at most
`B + (K + (k + 2)) · S` cells on `x` by time `T + 1 + t`. [AB09, Exercise 4.1: the universal
machine's space is the simulated machine's up to a factor depending on the code]

*Generalization.* The private form fixed the native endpoint (`d` the startup's layout at input
position `1`, `c` the encoding of `M`'s initial configuration). It read that endpoint only
through its exit control and the embedding identity, now the hypotheses `hexit` and `hcfg`; at
the native endpoint they are `rfl` and `Turing.embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init`, which is the old
statement. At `(K, k + 1)`, `d` the suffix-ruler layout and `c` the ruler host's presentation
(`Turing.suffixRulerCfg_embed`) it is the ledger of the suffix layout.

**Proof sketch.** The seam's visited-set theorem bounds each tape by the union
of its startup and loop visits. A selected loop tape has the source loop's
visited set; an unselected tape visits just its initial cell. Count each union
and sum over the host's tapes, using the public space equations. -/
theorem startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le {k K : ℕ} {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P]
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (exit : P)
    (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q) (entry : Q) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x) (d : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P x) (T : ℕ)
    (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) T = d) (hexit : d.state = some exit)
    (hcut : ∀ u < T, (R.runFrom (R.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some exit)
    (hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => entry) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2)))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c)
    (t B S : ℕ) (hB : R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg x) T ≤ B) (hS : 1 ≤ S)
    (hloop : ∀ i, L.spaceUsedByTape c t i ≤ S) :
    (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).spaceUsed ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x)
        (T + 1 + t) ≤ B + (K + (k + 2)) * S := by
  classical
  let σ := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 2 ≤ K + (k + 2))
  let A := embedEmitTM σ L
  let e := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c
  have he : d.mapState (fun _ => entry) = e := hcfg
  have hA : ∀ j, A.spaceUsedByTape e t j ≤ S := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range σ
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
      rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead σ L _ _ [] c t i).2]
      exact hloop i
    · rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame σ L _ _ [] c t j hj).2]
      exact hS
  have htape (j : Fin (K + (k + 2))) :
      (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).spaceUsedByTape
          ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) (T + 1 + t) j ≤
        R.spaceUsedByTape (R.initCfg x) T j + S := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
    have hsub := seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg R exit A entry
      (c₁ := d) (T₂ := t) hrun hexit hcut j
    rw [he] at hsub
    have hown : (startupLoopTM R exit L entry).visitedByTapeHead
        ((startupLoopTM R exit L entry).initCfg x) (T + 1 + t) j ⊆
        (seamCompTM R exit A entry).visitedByTapeHead
          ((R.initCfg x).mapState Sum.inl) (T + 1 + t) j := by
      intro p hp
      rw [MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff] at hp ⊢
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hp⟩ := hp
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      rw [startupLoopTM_initCfg, startupLoopTM, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀] at hp
      exact hp
    calc
      _ ≤ (R.visitedByTapeHead (R.initCfg x) T j ∪ A.visitedByTapeHead e t j).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (hown.trans hsub)
      _ ≤ (R.visitedByTapeHead (R.initCfg x) T j).card +
          (A.visitedByTapeHead e t j).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
      _ = R.spaceUsedByTape (R.initCfg x) T j + A.spaceUsedByTape e t j := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.add_le_add_left (hA j) _
  rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (R.spaceUsedByTape (R.initCfg x) T j + S) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => htape j
    _ = R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg x) T + (K + (k + 2)) * S := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.add_le_add_right hB _
